# Mathieu Aucejo

> Full professor of Structural Mechanics and Acoustics at Le Cnam (LMSSC), Paris. Inverse problems, vibration control and vibro-acoustics.

## Pages

- [Home](https://maucejo.github.io/)
- [Publications](https://maucejo.github.io/publications.html): Complete list of my publications, retrieved from the HAL open archive. Most items link to an open-access PDF.
- [Research](https://maucejo.github.io/research.html): Identifying, modeling and controlling vibrations and sound in mechanical structures.
- [Software](https://maucejo.github.io/software.html): Open-source packages for structural dynamics in Julia and templates for scientific writing in Typst.
- [Teaching](https://maucejo.github.io/teaching.html): Courses in structural mechanics, vibrations and acoustics at Le Cnam.
